scenes.headline: How one week of security news fits together
scenes.sub: Weak CA keys, two PHP bugs, a Node decoder, and the KEV list.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Vellum! This week brought broken certificate keys, two PHP bugs, a Node decoder flaw, and a long exploited list. Here's how they fit.

scenes.text: Patch by who is exploiting it and who can reach it, not by the CVSS number alone.
scenes.mark: who is exploiting it and who can reach it
scenes.say: The idea: rank by who is exploiting a bug and who can reach it. The CVSS number alone gets the order wrong.

scenes.title: Why a weak intermediate key matters

steps.say: A trusted root signs an intermediate. The intermediate's private key should be a huge random number.
These keys were tiny. Anyone who recomputed one could sign a certificate for any site, and clients would trust it.
Browsers pushed blocklists within hours. Software with its own trust store needs an update.

scenes.title: Where the PHP bugs live
scenes.say: The two PHP bugs sit in how a worker handles requests.

items.say: A request arrives, and PHP sets up its internal state.
An error stops the request part way through.
Cleanup, or the next request on that worker, trusts memory that is half-built or already freed.
The fixed releases reset that state. Restart every worker, or the old code keeps running.

scenes.title: Two ways to order the list

left.title: By CVSS
left.say: Sorting by CVSS puts the scariest worst case first.

right.title: By real-world risk
right.say: Sorting by risk asks three questions. Is it exploited, does it need a login, and can the internet reach it?

scenes.label: the published CVSS for both PHP bugs, not the leaked 10.0
scenes.say: The leak said ten. The published score for both PHP bugs is nine point two.

scenes.text: Update, restart, and check trust stores. A patched file on disk protects nothing until the process running it is new.
scenes.mark: A patched file on disk protects nothing
scenes.say: Update, restart, and check your trust stores. A patched file on disk protects nothing until the running process is new.

recap: Weak keys break the chain of trust
PHP fix needs a worker restart
scenes.say: Weak keys break trust. PHP needs a restart. Rank by exploitation and reach.
